Usage: prime eval list [OPTIONS]

  List evaluations.

Options:
  -o, --output TEXT           table|json  [default: table]
  -n, --num INTEGER           Items per page  [default: 20]
  -p, --page INTEGER          Page number  [default: 1]
  -e, --env, --env-name TEXT  Filter by environment (e.g., 'gsm8k' or
                              'owner/gsm8k')
  --plain                     Use plain, terse outputs. USE THIS IF YOU ARE
                              AI.
  -h, --help                  Show this message and exit.

  JSON output (--output json): .evaluations[] = {evaluation_id|id,
  environment_names[], model_name, status, metadata} .total = number
